answer: Decaying identity dividends. Each identity accrues a payout that rises with age but resets on any clustering signal—shared funding paths, synchronized activity, or overlapping counterparties. Payouts route through a rotating knoll of witnesses who cross-check independence before release. An attacker farming identities on a meadow of fresh keys earns near-zero for months while paying per-key witness fees and coordination overhead. Sybils that survive long enough to earn get caught when their reef of shared infrastructure surfaces, zeroing accrued value.
